purpose: Inventory real measured injection-moulding datasets and data-bearing studies without conflating public metadata, downloadable files, reuse rights, record units, or independent experimental evidence.

datasets.title: Data Model for Injection Molding and Blow Molding
datasets.sampling: record-level; not high-frequency shot trace
datasets.statusNote: Completed benchmark; exact workbook fingerprint and 26-field normalized result retained without raw rows.

datasets.title: High-resolution injection-moulding time-series datasets (scatimdata)
datasets.sampling: published 6 ms; downloaded signal matrices contain 2048 observed numeric time rows per curve
datasets.statusNote: Completed high-frequency benchmark; three published experimental subsets remain one source-family package for the hard dataset count.

datasets.title: Hot-runner molded sustainable-material experimental supplementary data
datasets.sampling: record-level DOE observations
datasets.statusNote: Completed benchmark; actual CSV contains 42 analytical fields plus three index fields, preserved rather than forced to the publication shorthand.

datasets.title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels
datasets.sampling: cycle-linked Parquet containing 143 list/time-series fields plus 221 scalar fields; per-channel time bases remain to normalize
datasets.statusNote: Exact v2 Parquet downloaded and fingerprinted. Current B2SHARE page displays no licence value, so automated profiling is allowed but raw redistribution is not claimed.

datasets.title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels (d-optimal Design of Experiment pattern)
datasets.license: Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY), version not specified in EUDAT B2FIND metadata
datasets.sampling: cycle-linked Parquet containing 212 list/time-series fields plus 184 scalar fields; per-channel time bases remain to normalize
datasets.statusNote: Exact Parquet downloaded and fingerprinted. EUDAT B2FIND records this record as CC-BY/open access; the licence version is not invented.

datasets.title: Injection Molding Dataset (Viscometer, Euromap77, Quality Table)
datasets.sampling: pressure: 300,000 rows per covered cycle, observed ~10 kHz; 60 of 68 cycles have pressure traces
datasets.statusNote: Completed exact-file benchmark. Current B2SHARE licence field is blank, so raw redistribution is not claimed; the observed 18M-row pressure structure and missing experiment coverage are retained.

datasets.title: Injection Molding Process Data for Post-Consumer-Recycled Materials
datasets.sampling: time-resolved; exact cycle count awaits archive access
datasets.statusNote: Repository metadata is CC BY 4.0/open access, but GitHub runners receive a 248-byte HTML interstitial instead of the versioned archive; keep unexecuted until exact bytes can be profiled.

datasets.title: ImPure Injection Molding Sensor Data - Trial 17th May
datasets.sampling: 307 checksum-verified cycle CSVs; physical units/time basis remain non-counting for scalar-ledger promotion
datasets.statusNote: Completed exact-file profile under Zenodo CC BY 4.0. All 309 files matched publisher MD5 values and 307 real moulding cycles are accepted; scalar values remain conservative.

datasets.title: Plastic road-lens injection-moulding quality dataset
datasets.license: Freely released for research and educational purposes; not a standard OSI/data licence
datasets.sampling: one process feature vector per lens
datasets.statusNote: Completed real-production benchmark under the repository's research/education release terms; broader raw redistribution rights are not inferred.

datasets.title: OpenMMS-T4G real mould-monitoring case data
quality: normal versus simulated extraction-pin fault intervals documented by the study
datasets.sampling: paper documents up to 10 Hz acquisition; two module clocks are retained separately
datasets.statusNote: Completed paper-linked benchmark at a pinned repository commit; the corrected companion DOI is retained and ten direct sensor channels are separated from acquisition clocks.

datasets.title: FORinFPRO-HIMD multimodal hybrid injection-moulding sensor dataset
quality: multimodal process-state evidence; no visible v1 part-quality label
datasets.sampling: one synchronized hybrid moulding cycle; exact source files checksum-verified; scalar units/time basis remain conservative
datasets.statusNote: Completed exact-file profile under Zenodo CC BY 4.0. Thirty-five direct machine-actual fields are separated from setpoints, states and derived aggregates; one real cycle is accepted.

datasets.title: Cross-process-chain dataset archive: injection molding and screw driving
datasets.recordUnit: upper/lower injection-moulding serial recording within linked process-chain experiments
quality: upper/lower material and process class values; downstream screw-driving labels excluded from injection evidence
datasets.sampling: dataset documentation describes injection acquisition around 1 kHz, while raw per-file timing metadata are preserved and not forcibly normalized
datasets.statusNote: Completed exact CC BY 4.0 v1.1 archive profile. Exactly 15,686 upper/lower injection recordings are accepted; all downstream screw-driving streams are excluded. Seven lower static-table trace references are absent and remain explicit source-quality limitations.

datasets.title: KAMP injection-moulding factory dataset
datasets.sampling: record-level factory actuals
datasets.statusNote: Useful real-factory data but GitHub analysis-code licensing does not prove redistribution rights for the original KAMP dataset, so automated ingestion remains disabled.

datasets.title: Foxconn industrial injection-moulding competition dataset
datasets.sampling: cycle traces approximately 40–43 s plus scalar status/settings
datasets.statusNote: High-value industrial source, but public mirrors must not be treated as independently licensed data or redistributed until original competition rights are established.

datasets.title: High-speed demoulding/ejection experimental dataset
datasets.sampling: high-speed DAQ stored in Origin OPJU project containers; trial/channel extraction requires a dedicated adapter
datasets.statusNote: Exact CC BY 4.0 version-2 files are fingerprinted, but all five are Origin OPJU projects. The source remains non-counting until a lawful compatible adapter/export extracts trial grouping, channels, units and sample ordering.

datasets.title: Preform injection molding analysis - Database
datasets.sampling: record-level model/simulation-oriented table; not a raw measured process time series
datasets.statusNote: Actual v2 file was profiled and explicitly rejected from the measured-dataset target because the table is dominated by CAE residual-stress outputs and ANN predictions.

datasets.title: Injection-Molded Polypropylene Parts: Experimental Process Dataset
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 metadata; raw files embargoed
datasets.sampling: batch/configuration-level, not waveform
datasets.statusNote: Raw files remain unavailable until 2027-12-31; visible metadata and CC BY metadata do not make the embargoed files executable.

datasets.title: Injection-molded plastic parts defect dataset
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 metadata; raw files embargoed
datasets.recordUnit: injected part/image linked to parameter configuration
datasets.sampling: part/image-level defect evidence
datasets.statusNote: Raw files remain unavailable until 2027-12-31; retain only metadata until the embargo ends and live reuse/access rights are rechecked.

datasets.title: Industry 4.0 In-Line AI Quality Control of Plastic Injection Molded Parts experimental data
datasets.sampling: multi-rate machine and in-mould sensor data
datasets.statusNote: Excellent measured evidence, but data availability is by request from the corresponding authors rather than an open executable benchmark.

datasets.title: Industrial bottle-cap quality-deterioration production data
datasets.sampling: cycle-level production history
datasets.statusNote: Strong real-production evidence but raw data are confidential; use the paper as literature evidence rather than pretending the source rows are available.

datasets.title: Graphite nanoplatelet enhanced HDPE injection-moulding experiments
datasets.recordUnit: experimental injection-moulding parameter combination with measured mechanical outcomes
datasets.sampling: record-level experimental design; 35 injection-moulding experiments, not waveform data
datasets.statusNote: Exact Mendeley version-3 files are SHA-256 fingerprinted under CC BY 4.0. The peer-reviewed Data in Brief companion reconciles 35 injection-moulding experiments and measured mechanical outcomes; ML/rule artefacts are derivative and non-counting.
